newsitem.title: USA: Sun Coast says still trying to refinance debt.
newsitem.headline: Sun Coast says still trying to refinance debt.

text.p: Sun Coast Industries Inc said Monday it has been unable to refinance its bank debt with another lender so far and remains out of compliance on two of its debt covenants.
The company previously announced it was out of compliance and had intended to refinance its existing debt with another lender before filing its annual report on Form 10-K today.
The company has obtained a waiver from its existing lender as of June 30. Since the debt is subject to acceleration, it remains classified as current on its balance sheet as of June 30.

Sun Coast management continues to pursue various strategic and financial alternatives to address the situation, it said. Those alternatives include current discussions with other potential lenders regarding the possibility of refinancing.

The company said it believes it will be able to retain new financing through alternative sources. However, such alternatives may be on terms less favorable than under the current arrangement, it said.
